title: Second Brain
intro: What your business knows, in one place. Every agent reads it through its own view; you decide what changes.
lensHint: Faded subjects and hidden values are outside this agent's view.
mapAria: Map of subjects: size is the number of facts, colour is what needs attention
mapEmptyBody: Add your first documents - price lists, policies, procedures, files or Google Drive links. NIVO indexes them and every agent can use them.
reviewEmptyBody: Proposals from agents, staff and customers land here before any agent uses them.
applied: Applied. The old value moved to history and agents are being updated.
scopePublicHint: Every agent, including the chatbot that talks to customers.
scopeInternalHint: Internal agents only (sales, accounting...). Never the chatbot.
fSubjectHint: A product, a service, a policy, a customer, the business itself...
reinforced: Same as the current value: added as more evidence.
lessonsIntro: How each agent should work. Lessons come from your edits of their drafts and from what you write here.
mineNotEnough: Only {n} corrections so far. At least 3 are needed to see a pattern.
mineDone: {n} lessons proposed from {c} corrections ({k} kept as test cases).
mineUnavailable: The model could not answer now. Try again in a few minutes.
loadFailed: The Second Brain could not be loaded. Your documents and facts are safe; try again.
processingBody: NIVO is reading them in the background. You can keep working; this page updates by itself.
gapsTitle: Questions customers asked with no answer yet
gapsIntro: The agent could not answer these from what it knows. Add the answer and every agent can use it.
gapsEmpty: Nothing is waiting: every question customers asked so far was answered.
gapDismissed: Dismissed. It will not be listed again.
lensIntro: One brain; each agent sees only its part.
startHint: What customers ask most. Agents answer from it as soon as you save.
how1: Agents, staff and customers only propose. You decide.
how2: A new value keeps the old one in history; a future date waits for its day.
how3: Your edits of agents' drafts become lessons you approve.
sAddressHint: Where customers come, how to park.
sHotlineHint: The number customers call or message.
sPaymentHint: Cash, transfer, card; the account to pay into.
sReturnsHint: When and how customers can return or claim.
sxBkServicesHint: Name, duration and price of each service.
sxBkStaffHint: Who or what takes bookings, buffer between slots.
sxBkExceptionsHint: Days closed or hours that change.
sxLyEarnHint: How much spend earns a point, multipliers, caps.
sxLyRewardsHint: What points can be redeemed for, and how many.
sxLyTiersHint: Tier names, how to reach each, what it gives.
sxLyExpiryHint: When points expire and how members are warned.
sxInSuppliersHint: What each supplier sells, lead time, minimum order, payment terms.
sxInReorderHint: Minimum stock and the quantity to order.
sxInUnitsHint: Purchase vs usage units and quantity per item.
sxShPayHint: Headcount per shift, pay rates, overtime.
sxShRulesHint: Shift times, weekly hour cap, rest between shifts.
sxHrRolesHint: Duties and requirements of each role you are hiring.
sxHrProcessHint: Each stage, who runs it, how long.
sxHrBenefitsHint: Probation, insurance, bonus, leave you can mention.
sxHrSalaryHint: Pay range per role. Restricted: never shown to candidates.
sxCtPillarsHint: The 3-5 themes you post about and their share.
sxCtBannedHint: Words and promises never to use.
sxCtOffersHint: Upcoming offers and events by date.
sxVdBrandHint: Logo, colours, fonts, music, aspect ratios.
sxVdOffersHint: Products and offers to push, dates, call to action.
sxLgIcpHint: Who is worth pursuing: who, where, budget, need.
sxLgQuestionsHint: The questions to ask a new lead, in order.
sxLgScoringHint: Signals of each level and the next step.
sxLgObjectionsHint: Common pushbacks and the reply you want.
sxLgOffersHint: Prices and offers that may be shared openly.
sxLgForbiddenHint: Promises never to make to a prospect.
sxLgRoutingHint: Call-back hours and who takes hot leads.
asked: Left open. Ask {who}, then come back to decide.
splitDone: Kept both: a separate fact was added for that situation.
conflictGroupHint: {n} different values for the same item. Pick the right one; the others are rejected.
picked: Picked. The other values were rejected and agents are being updated.
keptCurrent: Kept the value in use. The proposals were rejected.
retireBody: "{value}" rested only on a document that changed or was deleted. Stop using it, or keep it?
retiredDone: Stopped using it. It stays in the history.
creditsOut: Out of credits: the documents are saved but their facts have not been read yet. Top up credits to continue.
reasonSchedule: The new value starts on {date}. Schedule it: “{current}” stays in force until then.
reasonScheduleNew: The new value starts on {date}. Schedule it: agents start using it on that day.
reasonFirstTrusted: Nothing is recorded for this yet; {who} is a trusted enough source ({trust}).
reasonFirstUntrusted: New information from a less trusted source ({trust}). Confirm it before agents use it.
reasonSplit: “{value}” looks tied to one situation ({situation}). Both may be true: keep “{current}” and add a separate fact for that situation.
reasonSystem: Fresh figures from a connected system ({who}), backed by a reconciled record; “{current}” is older. Apply it; the old figure goes to history.
reasonRejectCustomer: “{current}” was confirmed by {by} (trust {currentTrust}); the proposal comes from a customer message (trust {trust}) and may be mistaken. Keep the current value.
reasonRejectAi: “{current}” was confirmed by {by} (trust {currentTrust}); the proposal comes from the AI inference (trust {trust}) and may be mistaken. Keep the current value.
reasonNewer: The new source ({who}, trust {trust}) is as trusted as the old one ({currentTrust}) and newer. Apply it; “{current}” goes to history.
reasonStale: “{current}” has not been confirmed for {days} days. Apply the new value; the old one goes to history.
reasonAsk: The sources disagree and the new one ({trust}) is less trusted than the old one ({currentTrust}). Ask {who} before deciding.

maintainTitle: The brain needs bringing up to date
maintainBody: A value is due to take over, or a value in force has ended. Update it so agents read the right one.
